/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'base-utility-heavy-hover|line-utility|base-generic-ultralight|spacing-half' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12 && git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.css && cat .gitignore"

'selected-row' : ''}\", \"rowClassName={row => "'`${row?.original.children ? '"'group-row' : ''} "'${row?.getIsSelected() ? '"'selected-row' : ''}"'`} renderGroupHeader={({row, getGroupTitle}) =>
